facts.label: official

facts.text: Nokia India recorded a cumulative turnover of Rs 150,700.44 crore across the seven financial years from 2005-06 to 2011-12.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: In fact about 50% of Nokia hand-sets were manufactured in India and 40%/50% of the production was exported.
facts.text: The Chennai factory accounted for about 50 percent of Nokia's global handset production, with up to half of that volume exported.

facts.label: official
facts.text: The Income Tax Department raised a total projected liability of Rs 20,299 crore against Nokia India and Nokia Corporation, encompassing tax, interest, and penalties.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: Learned WPC 6150/2013 Page 8 of 36 Counsel for the applicant had pointed out that Nokia India has huge investments in India and total value of fixed assets was Rs. 586.30 crores.
facts.text: The tax authorities' provisional attachment order froze Nokia India's fixed assets valued at Rs 586.30 crore alongside 15 bank accounts, blocking the plant's transfer to Microsoft.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: By 2008, Sriperumbudur had become a special economic zone with over US$2 billion invested by companies primarily in the automotive and electronics sectors.
facts.text: The industrial corridor of Sriperumbudur drew over 2 billion USD in corporate investments across the automotive and electronics sectors by 2008.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: In case of any retrenchment of a worker by an employer, the employer will need to contribute equivalent to 15 days' last drawn wages of the retrenched worker, within 45 days of retrenchment.
facts.text: Under the Industrial Relations Code 2020, retrenched workers are entitled to an employer contribution of 15 days' last drawn wages to a worker re-skilling fund.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: The code establishes that the industrial establishment, employing 300 or more workers, shall require prior permission from the appropriate Government, for lay-off, retrenchment, or closing down its industrial establishment.
facts.text: The Industrial Relations Code 2020 mandates that establishments employing 300 or more workers must obtain prior government permission before undertaking retrenchment, lay-off, or closure.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: On termination or resignation; wages must be paid within two working days.
facts.text: The Code on Wages 2019 requires employers to disburse unpaid wages within two working days of termination, retrenchment, or resignation to shield families from sudden liquidity shocks.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: Under Section 53 of the code, the Government has redcued the eligibility requirement for gratuity for Fixed Term Employees (FTEs) from five years to one year.
facts.text: Under Section 53 of the Code on Social Security 2020, fixed-term employees become eligible for terminal gratuity after completing one year of continuous service instead of five years.
